notes.text: Don't retry the refresh_token grant as is. Since v3.2 Keyline rotates refresh tokens and revokes the whole token family when a used one is re-sent. A timeout can hit after the server rotated, so a plain retry signs every device out. Our vendor doc copy is v3.1 and predates this.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: Safe retry: send one Idempotency-Key header, reused across all attempts of the same refresh (transport.post(path, body, { headers })). Keyline (v3.4+) replays the first response for 60 s and skips reuse detection. Never reuse the key for a different refresh token.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: SessionGuard retries an API call once after a 401. A refresh that fails with 400 invalid_grant is never retried: the family is gone, so sign the user out.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: post() rejects with TransportError (code ETIMEDOUT or ECONNRESET) only when no HTTP response arrived. Extra headers such as Idempotency-Key go in options.headers.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: TokenStore is in-memory per tab; two tabs refresh independently. Cross-tab sync via BroadcastChannel was tried and dropped (Safari bugs).
notes.author: codex

notes.text: SessionGuard retries the original API call once after a refresh but does not replay its body stream; streaming uploads fail on 401 and must be retried by the caller.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: Transport timeout is 10 s for all calls; raising it per endpoint was rejected to keep the UI responsive.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: To test against staging set KEYLINE_BASE_URL; the default points at production Keyline.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: signIn must not log the password or the full token response; the logging middleware redacts only known field names.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: Access tokens last 15 minutes and refresh tokens 30 days of inactivity (§5); the UI refreshes 60 s before expiry.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: FakeTokenServer's clock is real time; tests that wait for expiry are slow. Inject a clock if you add one.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: index.js is the public entry for the web and desktop clients; keep exports stable.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: Never call signOut from inside a request interceptor: it re-enters SessionGuard and deadlocks pending requests.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: Tests build a fresh FakeTokenServer per test; don't share one across tests, its state leaks.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: signOut doesn't revoke the refresh token server-side yet (Keyline /revoke); the token stays valid until it expires.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: Tokens are not persisted to localStorage on purpose (XSS exposure); a page reload signs the user out.
notes.author: claude-code
